note: Concrete non-runtime verification designs for the 45 source-backed spine requirements. This catalogue does not imply the broader mature domain decomposition is complete.

cases.title: Stable product identity
cases.stimulus: Represent one product through two aliases/transports; both resolve to one ProductId and prior observations remain addressable.
cases.expected: Product identity remains stable across repository rename, alias, transport, and UI representation.
cases.adversarial: A repository rename must not create a second product identity or orphan prior observations.
cases.isolation: fresh deterministic fixture; no unrelated product/baseline evidence may influence result
evidence_contract: evaluation timestamp when time semantics apply

cases.title: Accepted baseline immutability
cases.stimulus: Accept a baseline, accept a proposal changing intent, and observe a later revision while the prior revision remains queryable unchanged.
cases.expected: Changing accepted product intent creates a distinct accepted baseline revision through an explicit change workflow; prior accepted revisions remain unchanged.
cases.adversarial: Draft/rejected proposals or in-place edits must not alter an accepted baseline.
cases.isolation: fresh deterministic fixture; no unrelated product/baseline evidence may influence result
evidence_contract: evaluation timestamp when time semantics apply

cases.title: Typed accepted intent
cases.stimulus: Persist/retrieve each intent kind and lifecycle status at the exact baseline.
cases.expected: Accepted intent distinguishes requirements, obligations, capabilities, and measurable targets and retains lifecycle status.
cases.adversarial: Do not collapse all intent into an untyped description or erase deferred/retired history.
cases.isolation: fresh deterministic fixture; no unrelated product/baseline evidence may influence result
evidence_contract: evaluation timestamp when time semantics apply

cases.title: Observation scope binding
cases.stimulus: Evidence for product A/baseline 1 affects only that assessment.
cases.expected: Every observation binds to an exact product and baseline; capability-scoped observations also bind to the intended capability.
cases.adversarial: Evidence from another product, baseline, or capability must not change the target assessment.
cases.isolation: fresh deterministic fixture; no unrelated product/baseline evidence may influence result
evidence_contract: evaluation timestamp when time semantics apply

cases.title: Observation provenance
cases.stimulus: Retrieve an observation and explain who/what produced it and from which artifact.
cases.expected: Observations retain collector identity/version, recording time, result, and source artifact reference when available.
cases.adversarial: A bare pass/fail with no attributable producer must not be treated as equivalent evidence.
cases.isolation: fresh deterministic fixture; no unrelated product/baseline evidence may influence result
evidence_contract: evaluation timestamp when time semantics apply

cases.title: Append-only observations
cases.stimulus: Append a later observation and confirm the prior observation and baseline remain unchanged/addressable.
cases.expected: Recording later observations does not mutate accepted intent or rewrite earlier observations.
cases.adversarial: Updating an old failure in place to become a pass is prohibited.
cases.isolation: fresh deterministic fixture; no unrelated product/baseline evidence may influence result
evidence_contract: evaluation timestamp when time semantics apply

cases.title: Truthful assessment states
cases.stimulus: Passing, failing, absent, stale, and conflicting fixtures produce distinct expected states.
cases.expected: Assessment distinguishes satisfied, violated, stale, unknown, and inconclusive according to admissible evidence.
cases.adversarial: Unknown, stale, missing, or conflicting proof must never fall through to Satisfied.
cases.isolation: fresh deterministic fixture; no unrelated product/baseline evidence may influence result
evidence_contract: evaluation timestamp when time semantics apply

cases.title: Deterministic assessment
cases.stimulus: Run a fixed fixture twice and compare status/counts/findings.
cases.expected: Identical accepted intent, observations, baseline, evaluation time, and configuration produce the same assessment and explanation.
cases.adversarial: Uncontrolled wall-clock or unrelated observations must not alter the same scoped fixture.
cases.isolation: fresh deterministic fixture; no unrelated product/baseline evidence may influence result
evidence_contract: evaluation timestamp when time semantics apply

cases.title: Missing proof is not success
cases.stimulus: Assess accepted required intent with zero qualifying observations and receive Unknown/non-green with explanation.
cases.expected: Required accepted intent without admissible proof evaluates to an explicit non-green state.
cases.adversarial: Empty observations or empty selected checks returning Satisfied is prohibited.
cases.isolation: fresh deterministic fixture; no unrelated product/baseline evidence may influence result
evidence_contract: evaluation timestamp when time semantics apply

cases.title: Conflicting proof is explicit
cases.stimulus: Contemporaneous qualifying pass+fail evidence yields a non-green conflict state/finding.
cases.expected: Conflicting admissible evidence is represented as inconclusive/contradictory rather than arbitrarily selecting green.
cases.adversarial: Last-write-wins selection of a pass while hiding a failure is prohibited.
cases.isolation: fresh deterministic fixture; no unrelated product/baseline evidence may influence result
evidence_contract: evaluation timestamp when time semantics apply

cases.title: Freshness dissatisfaction

cases.expected: Tracera identifies accepted capabilities whose available evidence exceeds the configured freshness threshold and explains the stale source.
